core_values: Universal public services as human rights
Solidarity across racial, gender, and national lines
Democratic planning of key economic sectors

economic_policy.taxation: Steeply progressive income tax with top marginal rates above 60%; annual wealth tax on net assets over $10 million; financial transaction tax; close all offshore tax havens.
spending_priorities: Universal healthcare, childcare, and elder care
Free public education through postgraduate level
Green industrial policy and federal jobs guarantee
economic_policy.trade: Fair trade over free trade; binding labour rights, living wages, and environmental protections in all agreements; oppose investor-state dispute mechanisms that empower corporations over governments.
economic_policy.regulation: Break up monopolies and concentrated industries; mandate worker representation and profit-sharing; cap executive-to-worker pay ratios at 20:1; nationalise natural monopolies.

social_policy.healthcare: Single-payer universal healthcare; abolish private insurance for covered services; nationalise pharmaceutical manufacturing for essential drugs; healthcare as a constitutional right.
social_policy.education: Free public education from pre-K through graduate school; cancel all student debt; fund community schools as neighbourhood hubs; democratic school governance with parent and teacher control.
social_policy.housing: Housing as a fundamental right; massive public and social housing expansion; national rent control and anti-eviction protections; community land trusts; ban corporate ownership of residential property.
social_policy.civil_rights: Intersectional justice framework; reparations study and programme; decriminalise poverty; abolish cash bail and private prisons; full labour rights for gig and undocumented workers.
social_policy.immigration: Open and humane immigration; abolish immigration detention centres; full labour rights and public services for all residents regardless of status; generous path to citizenship.

governance.decentralization: Democratic workplace governance and cooperatives; participatory budgeting at all levels of government; community control of police and public services.
governance.transparency: Ban the revolving door between government and industry; publicly financed elections only; public ownership of government data; radical lobbying transparency.
governance.electoral_reform: Proportional representation; abolish legislative filibuster mechanisms; lower voting age to 16; same-day registration; make Election Day a national holiday.

environment.climate_action: Green New Deal: emergency decarbonisation by 2035; treat climate crisis as an existential emergency; just transition with guaranteed reemployment and retraining for displaced workers.
environment.energy: 100% publicly owned renewable energy system; ban all new fossil fuel extraction immediately; retrofit all public buildings for energy efficiency; free public transit nationwide.
environment.conservation: Environmental justice as a core principle; prioritise pollution reduction in frontline communities; ban single-use plastics; regenerative agriculture subsidies; rights of nature in law.

security.defense: Cut military budget by at least 50%; close overseas bases; redirect savings to social programmes and climate adaptation; end all arms sales to authoritarian regimes.
security.law_enforcement: Defund and fundamentally reimagine policing; invest in restorative justice, housing, mental health, and community safety as the real foundations of public security; abolish private prisons and end mass incarceration.
security.foreign_policy: Anti-imperialist foreign policy; international solidarity with workers' and liberation movements; support self-determination of peoples; cancel Global South debt; withdraw from military alliances.
